body:
> Note: The SVG format explicitly allows ECMA script in almost all contexts, so it may not be possible to block all SVG XSS vectors completely. If SVG upload is required, we strongly recommend either serving these uploaded files as text/plain or using a separate user-supplied content domain to prevent successful XSS from taking over the application.

The section V5.2 talks about sanitization, safe usage in web UI is covered by requirements in "V50.6 Unintended Content Interpretation".

Recommending to serve content as text/plain may not match with x-content-type-option: nosniff or other ideas, that asked resource content-type must match with the actual content.

I'll handle PR when #2456 PR's are done at least to step 2.2 to avoid conflicts.
